apps.name: comicgen
apps.page_title: comicgen: turn a short story into a comic book on your own PC | Loop Forge
apps.tagline: Give it a short story and get back a lettered comic book. An LLM writes the script, ComfyUI image models draw the cast and every panel, and code letters the balloons, all on your own PC.

hero.alt: Three finished comic pages made with comicgen

apps.note: comicgen is a Python program that drives your own ComfyUI. The model files aren't included: the table under Set it up links each one, about 32 GB in all.

needs: NVIDIA graphics card with 12 GB (made on an RTX 3060 12 GB with 32 GB RAM)

steps.title: Get the code
steps.text: Clone the repository and install its Python packages.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/loopforge0/comicgen.git
cd comicgen
pip install -r requirements.txt

steps.title: Add the models to ComfyUI
steps.text: Download each file into the ComfyUI models folder shown, then start ComfyUI. It has to be listening on 127.0.0.1:8188.

steps.title: Check that everything is in place
steps.text: This asks ComfyUI which nodes and model files it has, and lists anything missing with the folder it goes in.

steps.title: Make a comic
steps.text: Create a project from a story, then run, review and approve it in the tracker at http://127.0.0.1:8765. Four public-domain stories come with the code.
steps.code:
python -m comicgen new elves --story stories/elves_and_the_shoemaker.txt --style teen_humour
python -m comicgen ui

steps.title: Or go straight through
steps.text: One command from story to finished pages, with no stops and no LLM call leaving your PC. The pages land in projects/elves/pages/.

features.title: The same cast in every panel
features.text: Every character gets a turn-around sheet first, and every panel is drawn with those sheets as references. A change of clothes is drawn as an edit of the original, so the face carries over.

features.title: Lettering by code
features.text: The model draws each panel with balloons so the picture leaves room for them. SAM finds them, an edit removes them, and code letters the script's exact words back in.

features.title: You approve the cast
features.text: Every character, version and view in one place. Try a different look in plain words before any panel is drawn.

features.title: Change the story bible
features.text: Ask the LLM to change the cast, or edit it by hand. Only the pictures whose look changed are drawn again.

features.title: Edit the script
features.text: The script audit lists open problems. Fix them yourself or ask the LLM, panel by panel, then approve the script.

features.title: A reader for the finished comic
features.text: Read it page by page or panel by panel. It's written as a folder that opens offline in any browser.

apps.name: Qwen Image Editor
apps.tagline: Edit and create images with Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo on your own computer, in a simple editor or from Claude Desktop, ChatGPT and Goose.

hero.alt: Qwen Image Editor inside a chat app

downloads.needs: NVIDIA graphics card with 12 GB+, driver 580 or newer, 32 GB RAM recommended, about 25 GB free disk
Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 14 or newer

apps.note: The installers don't include the model. On first start the editor checks your computer, you accept Qwen's licence on Hugging Face, and the model downloads to your machine.

features.title: Point at what to change
features.text: Circle parts of an image in colours and describe each change. The circles are removed from the result.
features.prompt: Replace the earring in the red circle with a small silver stud, and remove the tattoo in the green circle. Keep everything else unchanged.

features.title: See what changed
features.text: Compare with a slider, side by side, or a Changes view that marks every edited pixel in red.

features.title: Transparent images
features.text: Make cut-outs and stickers with real transparency, or extract an object from a busy photo.
features.prompt: This is an RGBA image with transparency. Extract the latte cup and saucer from <image1> onto a transparent background. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.

features.title: Inside your chat app
features.text: Claude Desktop, ChatGPT and Goose can generate and edit, and open the editor in the chat so you can step in.

features.title: Loop mode
features.text: The agent makes an image, reviews it against a checklist, and fixes what fails, round after round until it passes.
